scope: All 94 residual popȯl-family tokens in live v019 Latin sources: two in paper 45 and 92 in papers 1-43.
choice: Resolve the family by meaning: 80 complete-reducibility terms to established poln- reducibil-, thirteen generic completely/entirely adverbs to cělkom, and the one perfect-field predicate to doskonalo.
motivation: A blind replacement would conflate technical completeness, generic totality, and field-theoretic perfection. Exact German context and existing reader terminology support a complete no-hold three-way split that removes the type-2 East/Southeast-shaped doublet.
alternatives_rejected: Blind popolno to cělkom: breaks eighty inflected complete-reducibility terms and the perfect-field distinction.
Blind popol- to pol-: yields unnatural generic polno jasno/analogno and mislabels a perfect field.
Retain the type-2 family: preserves a source-stratum duplicate of established poln- reducibil- terminology.
Use doskonalo globally: conflates ordinary completeness with field-theoretic perfection.

entries: id10921 popȯlno, type2, completely/absolutely/thoroughly, Southeast/East weighted

german_authority.finding: The technical sites are vollständig reducibil-, the field site is vollkommener Körper, and the remaining sites are ordinary complete/entire adverbs.

reader_precedent.complete_reducibility: Twenty-two established poln- reducibil- sites already occur before this edit.
reader_precedent.perfect_fields: EDIT-0048 binds field-theoretic perfect to the doskonal- family.
